clues.it: Giada era seduta su una sedia e nella stessa stanza di Luca.
clues.en: Giada was sitting on a chair and in the same room as Luca.

clues.it: Luca era nella 1ª colonna, accanto a un carro e a nord di Marta.
clues.en: Luca was in the 1st column, beside a wagon and north of Marta.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 7ª colonna, a ovest di Bruno e nelle Stalle.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 7th column, west of Bruno and in the Stables.

clues.it: Fabio era nella 11ª colonna, nella 4ª riga e a nord di Dario.
clues.en: Fabio was in the 11th column, in the 4th row and north of Dario.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Marta era nella 6ª riga, accanto a un cavallo e a nord di Dario.
clues.en: Marta was in the 6th row, beside a horse and north of Dario.

clues.it: Bruno era seduto su una sedia e a nord di Anna.
clues.en: Bruno was sitting on a chair and north of Anna.

clues.it: Tea era a nord di Carla e nell'Ufficio dello Sceriffo.
clues.en: Tea was north of Carla and in the Sheriff's Office.

clues.it: Dario era nella 6ª colonna ed esattamente una riga a nord di Anna.
clues.en: Dario was in the 6th column and exactly one row north of Anna.

clues.it: Anna era nella 8ª colonna, in una stanza diversa da Olga e alla Stazione.
clues.en: Anna was in the 8th column, in a different room from Olga and at the Depot.

clues.it: Olga era nella 4ª colonna, accanto a un carro o a un pianoforte e in Banca.
clues.en: Olga was in the 4th column, beside a wagon or a piano and in the Bank.

clues.it: Vito era a ovest di Carla e in Banca.
clues.en: Vito was west of Carla and in the Bank.

clues.it: Carla era nella 13ª riga, accanto a un pianoforte e in una stanza diversa da Luca.
clues.en: Carla was in the 13th row, beside a piano and in a different room from Luca.

general_clues.en: 6 in the west half of the grid.
6 in the north half of the grid.

general_clues.it: 2 sedute su uno sgabello da saloon.
2 accanto a uno sgabello da saloon.

steps.it: L'indizio di Luca lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Luca's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 1st.

steps.en: Fabio can only be in the 11th column: ruling it out leaves Giada a single square: row 1st, column 5th.
